verses.text: Some men came down from Judea and started teaching the believers, “Unless you are circumcised according to Moses’ custom, you cannot be saved.” ⚠️
Paul and Barnabas strongly disagreed and debated them. The church appointed them and some others to go to Jerusalem and discuss the issue with the apostles and elders. 🗣️
The church sent them on their way. As they traveled through Phoenicia and Samaria, they told how Gentiles were turning to God, bringing great joy to all the believers. 🌍
When they arrived in Jerusalem, the church, apostles, and elders welcomed them. They reported everything God had done through them. 🙌
Some believers from the Pharisee group stood up and said, “Gentiles must be circumcised and ordered to keep the Law of Moses.” 📜
The apostles and elders gathered to consider the matter. 🏛️
After a long debate, Peter stood up and said, “Brothers, you know that some time ago God chose me to share the Good News with the Gentiles, so they could hear and believe. 📣
“God, who knows the heart, showed that he accepted them by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as he did to us. 🔥
“He made no distinction between us and them. He cleansed their hearts through faith. 💛
“So why are you testing God by putting a heavy yoke on the disciples—something our ancestors and we could not carry? 🪢
“We believe we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.” 🙏
The whole crowd fell silent and listened as Barnabas and Paul told about the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them. 👂
When they finished, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me. 🗣️
“Simeon has explained how God first looked to the Gentiles, choosing from among them a people to bear his name. 🌍
“This agrees with what the prophets wrote. Scripture says: 📖
“‘After this I will return. I will rebuild David’s fallen tent. I will rebuild its ruins and set it up again, 🏚️
“‘so that the rest of humanity may seek the Lord—including all the Gentiles who are called by my name. The Lord says this, and he has been making these things known from long ago.’” ✨
“God’s works have been known to him from eternity. ⏳
“So here is my judgment: we should not make life difficult for Gentiles who are turning to God. 🤝
“Instead, let us write to them to stay away from food polluted by idols, sexual immorality, meat from strangled animals, and blood. 📝
“For Moses has been preached in every city for generations and is read in the synagogues every Sabbath.” 📜

Then the apostles and elders, together with the whole church, chose men from their group to go with Paul and Barnabas to Antioch. They chose Judas, called Barsabbas, and Silas, respected leaders among the believers. 👥
They sent this letter with them: “From the apostles, elders, and fellow believers, to the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings. ✉️
“We heard that some people from among us came and upset you with their words, troubling you and saying you must be circumcised and keep the Law. We never gave them that command. ⚠️
“So we have agreed together to choose representatives and send them to you with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul, 🤝
“who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. ✝️
“We are sending Judas and Silas too. They will tell you the same message in person. 🗣️
“The Holy Spirit and we have agreed not to place any extra burden on you beyond these essentials: 🔥
“Stay away from food offered to idols, from blood, from meat of strangled animals, and from sexual immorality. If you avoid these things, you will do well. Farewell.” 👋
The messengers left for Antioch, gathered the church, and delivered the letter. 📬
When the believers read it, they were encouraged and glad. 😊
Judas and Silas, who were prophets, encouraged and strengthened the believers with many words. 💪
After spending some time there, the brothers sent them back in peace to those who had sent them. 🕊️
Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and sharing the Lord’s message with many others. 📣
Some time later, Paul said to Barnabas, “Let us go back and visit the believers in every city where we shared the Lord’s message. Let us see how they are doing.” 🛤️
Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, along with them. 👣
But Paul did not think they should take him, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in the work. ⚖️
Their disagreement became so sharp that they separated. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus, 🌊
but Paul chose Silas and left after the believers entrusted him to the Lord’s grace. 🙏
He traveled through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches. 💪
